applicabilityBasis.summary: USSD is a non-yield, dollar-denominated payment/settlement branded token. The issuer-linked disclaimer describes a 1:1 wrapper of deposited frxUSD: holders first unwrap USSD into frxUSD through smart contracts, then seek any upstream redemption through Frax/providers. Sonic promotes payments and GENIUS-compatible infrastructure, but is expressly not the issuer. Apparent-payment-stablecoin describes payment positioning, not an unconditional dollar-redemption finding.

genius.notes: USSD is a separate non-yield branded wrapper deployed by Frax Inc. and affiliates. The token-linked disclaimer states that Sonic Labs does not issue, administer, control or endorse the token; Frax documentation maps this exact token address to a BrandedCustodian holding frxUSD 1:1. Holders unwrap USSD into frxUSD before seeking upstream redemption; no unconditional direct USSD fiat obligation is inferred. The existing issuer-announced-intent status is retained solely as a token-specific partner signal under the tracker rubric: Sonic promotes USSD itself as GENIUS-compatible, including full-compliance marketing. This language does not establish legal compliance, a filed application, an approved issuer route, or official authorization. FIP-430/FIP-432 concern Frax intent for frxUSD; their proposed license is not automatically inherited by USSD. The disclaimer supplies the Frax legal-issuer/deployer mapping, while the GENIUS positioning is attributed to Sonic rather than represented as a Frax regulatory undertaking. Existing issuerEntity Frax Inc. is preserved; the frxusd-frax sibling uses the fuller Financial Reserves and Asset Exploration Inc. name. Published USSD reserve composition describes upstream backing, not independently audited token-specific balances. The Frax Facts page returned a client shell and current figures were not verified; no USSD monthly CPA attestation was located. Treasury continues to describe an expected January 18, 2027 effective date; general DASP restrictions are not yet active.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public token-specific USSD PPSI approval, acknowledged GENIUS application, state qualification, foreign-exception decision or enforcement action was found in the consulted primary materials and exact-brand official-domain search. Sonic supplies token-specific GENIUS positioning as a partner, not an issuer approval. Frax governance proposals concern upstream frxUSD and do not establish a USSD-specific filing. The OCC licensing tracker returned navigation-only reader content and was not treated as a complete inspected application list.
